name: Developing Image
description: A frame that develops an image: a band of shimmering water-toned cells sweeps down, turning a pixel haze into the picture.

props.name: src
props.description: The finished image. It is shown with object-fit: cover. Changing it starts the sweep again.

props.name: alt
props.description: Text alternative for the image. The frame sets aria-busy until the image is revealed.

props.name: progress
props.description: Controlled progress from 0 to 1. The band eases toward it. Leave it out to sweep on a timer instead.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the sweep when progress is not given.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Size of a cell in pixels.

props.name: bandHeight
props.description: Height of the scanning band as a fraction of the frame.

props.name: effect
props.description: How the cells in the band move: each on its own beat, or in a wave travelling across. They hold still under reduced motion.

props.name: colors
props.description: Water tones for the band. The first also colours its leading edge.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called once the band has reached the bottom and the overlay has faded.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame, which needs a size, for example aspect-[4/3] w-full rounded-2xl. Other div props are passed through.
